findings.failure_path: SCOPE_LIMIT is inserted into both general stop reminders and instructs the agent to adopt any recommendable answer. Unlike requester-default, it has neither the sole-accountable-requester condition nor the exception for requests requiring consultation. A team planning task with a reserved product decision therefore receives instructions to adopt a recommendation instead of obtaining the required decision.
findings.smallest_fix: Qualify default adoption with the canonical sole-owner conditions and preserve explicit consultation requirements. Add negative coverage for a team-owned decision and a requester who explicitly requires consultation.

findings.failure_path: The final-round table leaves P7 unresolved and substitutes second-round quality results even though the third round changes decision behavior. P3 also remains below its preregistered threshold despite the plan requiring correction or withdrawal of unsupported changes. No actual results for the repository-mandated deterministic checks are supplied. The bounded evidence therefore cannot establish acceptance for this candidate.
findings.smallest_fix: Provide candidate-bound validation results and the final-round P7 assessment; resolve P3 through correction and reevaluation or withdraw the unsupported portion.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: requester-default introduces a fourth closure method while leaving row closure and PRD Ready to external lifecycle rules. Those consuming rules are absent, so the packet cannot establish whether valid defaults permit document generation or bypass remaining closure requirements. The selected installed skill bodies are also unavailable in the permitted packet, preventing verification of all requested review lenses.
findings.smallest_fix: Include the frozen selected skill bodies and relevant lifecycle closure/Ready rules in review context, with evidence tracing accepted requester-default fields and rejected unauthorized defaults through PRD Ready.
